author: CityVision TV
title: Holding a community event? Send it to us to be listed
summary: Share your event with the community. Send us the name, date, time, location and a short description.
body: Festivals, fundraisers, sports days, cultural nights: we would love to help spread the word. Send us your event with the name, date, time, location and a short description, and we will add it to our Events section.
